children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game in groups of four to mimic the dance formation.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the 4-beat rhythm using hand taps on knees while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Gentle weight shifts from side to side following the 4/4 meter with support.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo; focus on upper body sway.

social_formats.description: Performed as a couple dance or in groups of four.

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the percussive and melodic resonance of the santouri, playing a steady four-beat rhythm derived from a Turkish patinada.

teaching.level_notes: The dance is performed in social settings like weddings, suggesting it is accessible to community members.
